title: Albert Bender's three men in black teleport him to Antarctica

tellings.quote: these three men in black materialized in his attic. And he said they had he said they had glowing orange eyes and they smelled like sulfur

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels's podcast, retells the story of Albert Bender, a man who in the 1950s wrote a book called The Saucers and the Three Men. Bender said three men in black appeared out of nowhere in his attic, with glowing orange eyes and a smell of sulfur, and that they took him to Antarctica. If true, it would mean the beings behind UFOs can appear at will and move people across the world.
